headline: Temasek-Backed 65 Equity Partners Invests in Swedish Hypercar Maker Koenigsegg
summary: Singapore sovereign investor Temasek's fund 65 Equity Partners acquired a stake in Swedish luxury vehicle maker Koenigsegg. The funding will support production expansion and vehicle tech development.
why: Temasek Holdings is a Singapore state investment company managing over $280 billion in global assets.

impacts.name: Koenigsegg
impacts.why: Fresh private equity funding supports technology R&D and factory scaling.
